task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.65, 0.66, 0.17, 0.95] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
